description: Emotional clarity over time. The most common authority. Affects Generators, Manifesting Generators, Manifestors, and some Projectors.
decision_style: Never in the now. Need to ride the full emotional wave (high to low and back) before clarity emerges. True yes feels consistently good across multiple days and moods.
time_to_decide: Multiple days to weeks for important decisions. Minor decisions can be faster but should still avoid the emotional peak or trough.
career_application: Do not accept job offers on the spot. Sleep on major career decisions. If it still feels right when you're neither excited nor down, it's probably correct. Use waiting time to gather information rather than to overthink.
common_mistake: Deciding at the emotional peak (over-excitement) or trough (despair). Both distort the true signal.
